title: Jira Integration UI — Push to Jira Button on Every Finding
goal: Make the fully-implemented Jira backend integration visible and usable in the UI with a Push to Jira button per finding and integration configuration in Settings.
scope: The Jira backend (api/app/services/jira.py and POST /api/v1/findings/{id}/handoff-jira) is already fully implemented. This task makes it visible. Three UI changes: (1) FINDINGS DRAWER: when Jira is configured in Settings, show a Push to Jira button in the finding detail drawer. On click, call the existing POST endpoint. Show a spinner while pending. After success, show a green Jira badge with the ticket key (stored in FindingIntegrationLink table). Show the badge on finding rows in the list view too. (2) SETTINGS: add a Jira section in the Integrations accordion in Settings with fields: Jira base URL, project key, authentication method (API token or OAuth), and a Test Connection button. Store via the existing IntegrationConfiguration model. (3) BULK PUSH: in the Problems Center, add a Push selected to Jira option in the bulk actions bar when Jira is configured. This bulk-pushes selected findings to Jira in sequence.
generation_reason: Jira integration is fully implemented in backend but invisible in UI. Every security consultant uses Jira for ticket tracking. This is a high-value feature that costs minimal effort since the backend already exists.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Jira UI only. Backend already exists. No new Jira features (bidirectional sync, Jira webhooks) in this slice.

success_criteria: Push to Jira button visible in finding drawer when Jira configured.
Button calls existing handoff-jira endpoint correctly.
Jira ticket reference badge shown on finding after push.
Jira configuration section in Settings with test connection.
Bulk push works from Problems Center.

acceptance_criteria: Push to Jira button works. Badge shown after push. Settings configuration works.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
